ai_briefing.morning_summary: Crypto markets opened modestly higher, with Bitcoin up 0.8% and Ethereum gaining 0.4%, while DOGE and XRP posted strong gains. Institutional news on 24/7 settlement and continued Bitcoin ETF inflows support a bullish tilt, though SOL and BNB slipped and Ether ETFs saw outflows. Technical indicators suggest Bitcoin may break its recent resistance, and Ethereum faces staking exit pressure.
